svg.title: Source uncertainty and arbitrary priors. The example fixes source marginals. If each actual conditional ρ′ h has trace distance at most δS from ρh, the valid repair is B(ε) + δS ≤0 and QE ≥ QF −2r −δS. Indeed Ewrong −ε(E+ + E−) lies between −εI and (1 −ε)I; its spectral oscillation is at most one. This term bounds source error without mistaking a measured detector for a measured source. The combined radius/source certificate need not be sharp.
